No, under the majority rule the employer likely cannot enforce the covenant, because a covenant signed mid-employment needs new consideration, and continued at-will employment is illusory since the employer could have fired her at any time. A minority of states, such as Illinois, treat continued employment for a substantial period after signing (about two years) as sufficient, and she worked two years after signing, so enforcement could succeed there. Absent that rule or a new benefit such as a raise or promotion, the preliminary injunction should be denied.

CONFIDENCE: 75
